text:
maria: quick ping — found a 404 on the onboarding CLI page when linking to the emoji section: https://docs.redwood.inference/guides/cli#emoji  returns a 404. planning a tiny PR to fix the anchor and add a 1-line 'when to use emojis in examples' note. anyone actively owning that guide? :wave:
jon: not an owner but can help grep for other broken fragments. can you paste the failing fragment/heading?
maria: heading on page is 'Emoji guide' so the link should be `#emoji-guide` rather than `#emoji`. my proposed patch is literally 2-3 lines: 1) update the link, 2) add a one-sentence guideline (e.g., use :sparkles: for feature highlights, :warning: for warnings). will attach a tiny test for linkcheck.
tara: I own the onboarding CLI guide — thanks for catching it. small PRs are fine, open one and tag me. if CI passes I'll merge.
docs-bot: created task docs:linkfix-482 — "onboarding-cli anchor + emoji usage blurb" assigned to @tara, reported by @maria
maria: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/832 — includes a linkcheck run and a one-line copy suggestion. pinging for review.
jon: glanced at the diff — anchor change LGTM. left one nit about punctuation in the new sentence.
tara: will take over copy nit and merge after green CI. thanks for flagging, @maria :thumbsup:
maria: cool — thanks both! I'll run a quick repo-wide grep for other `#emoji` fragments and follow up if I find more.
